sequence: Require manifest capability and explicit abandoned+withdrawn acknowledgements; read diagnostic, assert reset, verifyfault0, release via fresh handshake, samplefaultagain
checks: NoMMIO if any acknowledgement/capability absent, even initialfault0
Initialfault0 never bypasses explicit reset; exactly3managementwrites
Any callbackfailure stops immediately at that call, no retry/cleanupwrites
Managementcallbacks assert only BASEidentity/status/fault and command addresses; no targetaccess
shape_valid invalidated before reset/release writes and failed statusreads
limits: Caller acknowledgements are obligations, not hardware detection
Host callbacks/ASanUBSan only; no A53compile or firmwareexecution for new sequence
Callbacks must return; no bound for a hung MMIO instruction
OK is management sequence plus sampledstatus, not targetready/liveclock/outcome proof
